idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; a quadrant is a heap record holding the spec's kernel, on its parent's worker, the root's child k on worker k % cores; a ConfirmExit hands the parent the child's record; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. A quadrant is one `new` and one `delete` around the spec's kernel, with no mailbox, no registry and no lifecycle beyond its record: the floor for routing the customers and growing the quadtree

the producer and the root on worker 0, a quadrant on its parent's worker and the root's child k on worker k % cores -- the same static placement qb has, so with cores=2 this floor bounds the placing frameworks and NOT the pools
cores=1 is one thread with every quadrant's messages in its own ring -- the floor for single-threaded dispatch, still a real queue
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable
